_doc: Per-agent model pins. Each entry is the (provider, model) an agent was last
validated against, with the date that validation happened.
The companion test (tests/v2/test_model_pins.py) resolves the live registry
assignment for user_id='0' and fails the build if any agent has drifted.
1. Run the live integration suite for the drifted agent(s):
2. Inspect the structured outputs for semantic drift (scores, decisions,
evidence quality) -- not just that the call succeeded.
3. Edit this file with the new {provider, model, validated_on}.
4. Commit the pin update separately from the config change so the
Baseline date below = 2026-05-28, the day this file was first created. Earlier
validations exist (per ADR-053/058 cost work) but were not date-stamped at the
pin layer, so this is the first authoritative pin record.
